info.name: Nigertoday TV Backend
info.description:
End-to-end check of B3-B7 together.

Setup:
1. .env: MOCK_TODAY=2026-10-05, REMINDERS_ENABLED=false (or true for folder 10), JOBS_ENABLED=false, DEMO_MODE=false.
2. npm run seed, then npm run dev.
3. Collection Variables: set baseUrl, adminEmail, adminPassword (CURRENT value, so secrets are not synced).
4. Run the collection with the Collection Runner (folders must run in order). Reseed before every full run.
5. Works with REMINDERS_ENABLED true or false: folder 4 probes it and folder 10 / the 403 items skip themselves. Needs Postman with pm.execution.skipRequest().
